about: The downstream check: each pinned commit of an outside repository is checked, tested, built and its cases run with the checkout's bin/ergo; a pin is a commit, a missing pin fails, and zero pins pass only before a path moves.

mutants.name: ds-missing-pin-skips
mutants.from:
fmt.Fprintf(r.out, "FAIL %s %s: not in the cache (%s); run go run ./scripts/downstream fetch\n", p.name, short, src)
		return false
mutants.rule: A pin that is not in the cache fails and names the fetch command; it is never skipped.

mutants.name: ds-cases-leg-dropped
mutants.rule: Each binary with a cases folder runs its cases (ergo test --cases).

mutants.name: ds-uses-path-ergo
mutants.rule: The check uses the checkout's bin/ergo (-ergo), never an ergo found on PATH.

mutants.name: ds-fetch-follows-branch
mutants.rule: A pin is a full commit hash; a branch or a tag is refused.

mutants.name: ds-zero-pins-pass-after-move
mutants.rule: Zero pins pass only while downstream/moved is empty.

mutants.name: ds-fetch-not-cached
mutants.from:
if info, err := os.Stat(dest); err == nil && info.IsDir() {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "cached
mutants.to:
if info, err := os.Stat(dest); false && err == nil && info.IsDir() {
			fmt.Fprintf(out, "cached
mutants.rule: A pin already in the cache costs no Git work.
